mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines over 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and rises by more than 0.2 percentage points over three months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: In 70% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% and rises by >0.2pp over 3 months, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between RSAFS and HOUST declines (Rank IC < 0.05) over 3-year rolling windows, or 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO below 95.0) combined with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0%), recession fears intensify, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: RSAFS rises above 12-month MA but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between PAYEMS and UNRATE declines (Rank IC < 0.05) over 3-year rolling windows, or 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns.
